# Terms of Use

> Markdown version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/termos>. v2.0 · updated on 8 May 2026. The text with normative value is the HTML page.

They regulate access and use of mauricio. issei.com.br and the services offered by Mauricio Yokoyama Issei. Navigate or interact with the website implies agreeing to these Terms.

## Summary

- The site is informative: professional portfolio, consulting proposals and educational content.
- Copying, reproducing or redistributing the content requires written authorization.
- Communications by WhatsApp and email depend on opt-in and can be cancelled at any time.
- Content generated by AI is identified; decisions with effect on the user undergo human review.
- Foro: São Paulo/SP, except for the consumer's right to choose the forum of their home.

## Subject matter

Portfolio, dynamic curriculum and technical proposals; educational content; contact and application forms for consulting; interactive tools, including with generative AI. **It's not** legal, accounting, tax or binding financial advice, and use does not generate employment.

## Capacity and accounts

Forms, contracts and any relationship with personal data require full civil capacity (≥ 18 years) or representation. Areas with credentials (e.g. administrative panel) require password and token confidentiality and immediate notice in case of misuse.

## Sealed conduct

Mass scraping or automation that overloads the infrastructure; reverse engineering or exploitation of vulnerabilities; illicit, offensive or discriminatory content; unauthorized use of trademarks; ideological falsehood (Marco Civil, Arts 7 and 8).

## Intellectual property

Texts, images, videos, audios, code, brands, slides and design are protected by Laws 9,610/1998 and 9.279/1996. Reproduction, distribution, modification or commercial exploitation depends on prior written authorization.

- **public `cv.json`:** can be consumed by automated agents (ATS, search AI) exclusively for professional evaluation. Commercial redistribution and model training require explicit consent.
- **News & takedown:** copyright notifications to mauricio@issei.com.br (subject "DMCA / Copyright"), with identification of the work, proof of ownership, location of the content and declaration of good faith.

## User Content

There are no public comment or upload areas. If there is, the author guarantees ownership and grants non-exclusive license for display on the site, in moderation compatible with the Digital Services Act (EU 2022/2065).

## Communication and WhatsApp

Forms authorize email or WhatsApp communications related to the request. Opt-out: reply **GET OUT** or use the deregistration link.

## Artificial intelligence

Features with LLMs (e.g. demonstrations of Knowledge OS) follow the EU AI Act: content generated by AI is labeled, can be inaccurate and must be validated, and decisions with effect on the user are not made only by AI (LGPD, art. 20).

## Payments

The site does not process payments. Hires follow their own instrument; distance hires are entitled to 7-day repentance (CDC, art. 49).

## Liability and compensation

There is no guarantee of uninterrupted availability or absence of errors. In the extent permitted by the law, there is no liability for the unavailability of external providers, indirect damage or third party content — without discharging irrefutable responsibilities from the CDC. The user indemnifies for unlawful use or violation of these Terms. External links follow the policies of each service.

## Modifications, suspension and privacy

Material changes are marked at the top of the page for 30 days; continued use implies acceptance. Access can be suspended in the event of rape. Data processing follows [Privacy Policy](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/privacidade) and [Cookie Policy](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/cookies).

## Disputes and forum

Friendly prior email attempt (response in up to 15 working days); optional mediation. Brazilian law; foro da Comarca de São Paulo/SP, with the exception of the consumer's home forum (CDC, art. 101, I).
